title: Robert William Denton, Native of Savoy, Dies
text:
Robert William Denton,
Native of Savoy, Dies

SAVOY—Funeral service will be held in Savoy Saturday at 2 p.m. for Robert William Denton, 63, a flooring contractor and native of Savoy, who died Wednesday afternoon in the Veterans Hospital in Little Rock, Ark. Burial will be in Sunnyside Cemetery, near here.

Mr. Denton was born Oct. 14, 1893, a son of the late Mr. and Mrs. Joe Denton. For the last three years he had lived in Mena, Ark. In May, 1919, he married Miss Mae Large here. He was a veteran of World War I.

Survivors are his wife; one daughter, Mrs. Francis Horner of Oklahoma; one son, Clarence Denton of Mena, Ark.; a brother, H. A. Denton of Denison; five grandchildren and two great grandchildren.
